name: Allocation actuation
threshold: >=0.75 snapshots at >=10% tiles for both baselines

name: Byte fairness
threshold: <=0.005; all cases under budget; zero fallback

name: Critical coverage
threshold: >=+0.10 at Severe/Low and primary CI low >0

name: Quality safeguard
threshold: critical PSNR >=-0.25 dB; full PSNR >=-1.0 dB at Severe/Low

name: Reproducibility
threshold: byte-identical regenerated sources, provenance and figures
